Genentech | 2027 Interns | PD Data Sciences & Analytics | ONSITE (South San Francisco, CA USA)

Want to find out how data shapes medicines for patients? Genentech's Product Development Data Sciences & Analytics team is hiring graduate students (Master's or PhD) for 12-week, full-time, on-site summer 2027 internships in South San Francisco.

Digital, AI & Clinical Outcome Assessments. Algorithm development with clinical data and medical images. AI and machine learning research. Patient-reported outcomes.

MRI, CT, OCT, DICOM, oncology, ophthalmology, neuroscience, python, pytorch, agentic workflows, statistics.

Apply by November 19, 2026.

https://go.gene.com/PDD-SSF-DigitalAI-Intern
